idea-plugin.name: GDPR Privacy Notice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
16 rules read your privacy.md the way Articles 13 and 14 read it

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → GDPR Privacy Notice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/gdpr-privacy-notice-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/gdpr-privacy-notice-lint

action.text: GDPR Privacy Notice Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run GDPR Privacy Notice Lint on the file in the editor
